name: io.github.n24q02m/telegram
title: Telegram MCP
description: Telegram for AI agents: messages, chats, media, and contacts in bot and user-account modes.

environmentVariables.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather (for bot mode)
environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Phone number in +<country><number> form for user mode (or save it once with `telegram auth --phone`)
environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_PHONE

environmentVariables.description: Optional Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org; overrides the bundled public API pair
environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_API_ID

environmentVariables.description: Optional Telegram API hash from my.telegram.org; overrides the bundled public API pair
environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_API_HASH

runtimeArguments.name: -p
runtimeArguments.description: Publish the image's HTTP port (8080) on loopback

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount a config.toml whose [server] auth is "token" (token_hash from `telegram token hash`); the image binds 0.0.0.0, which "no-auth" refuses

config_toml.description: Path to the config.toml on the host

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>, the token whose hash is token_hash in the mounted config.toml

environmentVariables.description: Telegram bot token from @BotFather (for bot mode)
environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
